{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_salmonella_serovar_20260401",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "normalized_peak_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the primary spectral peak around 553nm to the blue region around 477nm.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a scale-invariant measure of the primary spectral peak relative to the blue region, improving distance calculations by reducing the impact of absolute brightness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_78_W_553.20 / (Band_40_W_477.00 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_slope_550_600",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The linear slope between 550nm and 601nm.",
      "value_range": [-100.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "spectral_shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the local derivative of the spectrum, allowing the KNN model to group samples with similar spectral shapes regardless of baseline shifts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Band_102_W_601.00 - Band_77_W_550.90) / 50.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "low_freq_high_freq_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of visible light intensity to the near-infrared tail intensity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1500.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the visible light intensity against the near-infrared tail, creating a robust similarity score for neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Band_40_W_477.00 + Band_41_W_479.30) / (Band_200_W_796.40 + Band_201_W_798.60 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mid_spectrum_curvature",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Measures the convexity of the spectrum around the 553nm peak relative to its surrounding bands.",
      "value_range": [-2000.0, 5000.0],
      "feature_family": "spectral_shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures the convexity of the spectrum around the 550nm peak, providing a shape-based feature that enhances cluster separation in distance-based models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_78_W_553.20 - 0.5 * (Band_50_W_496.80 + Band_102_W_601.00)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_brightness_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average intensity across three representative bands spanning the visible spectrum.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4000.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates intensity across multiple bands to serve as a stable prototype-distance feature, helping to stratify the neighborhood space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Band_50_W_496.80 + Band_100_W_596.90 + Band_150_W_696.60) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_band_difference_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized difference between the 553nm peak and the 696nm region.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a bounded [-1, 1] similarity score that is highly robust to multiplicative scaling effects, ideal for KNN distance metrics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Band_78_W_553.20 - Band_150_W_696.60) / (Band_78_W_553.20 + Band_150_W_696.60 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "blue_green_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the 457nm band to the 517nm band.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights relative absorption differences in the shorter wavelengths, improving the local geometry of the feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_30_W_457.10 / (Band_60_W_517.00 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "red_edge_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between the 676nm and 696nm bands, capturing the steepness of the spectral drop-off.",
      "value_range": [-1000.0, 2000.0],
      "feature_family": "spectral_shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Quantifies the steepness of the spectral drop-off in the red region, acting as a strong discriminator for distance-based clustering.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_140_W_676.40 - Band_150_W_696.60"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_high_intensity_spectrum",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Boolean indicator (0 or 1) if the overall spectrum intensity is unusually high compared to the dataset average.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a cluster indicator for unusually bright samples, preventing them from disproportionately skewing the distances of typical samples.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_shape_cluster",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Categorical integer (0 to 5) assigning the spectrum to one of several unsupervised prototype shapes (e.g., flat, peaked, skewed).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Assigns samples to unsupervised prototype shapes, allowing the KNN to compute distances within more homogeneous sub-manifolds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "noise_level_estimate",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Estimated high-frequency variance in the near-infrared region (bands > 800nm).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 500.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Estimates high-frequency variance, which can be used to down-weight noisy neighbors or group samples with similar signal-to-noise ratios.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "baseline_shift_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Continuous score indicating the presence and magnitude of a baseline shift in typically dark regions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies non-zero baselines in the near-infrared region, helping the model distinguish between true spectral features and sensor artifacts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
